{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Hampton Roads Crossing''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.virginiaplaces.org/transportation/gaspipeline.html|title=virginiaplaces.org|website=virginiaplaces.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Hampton / Newport News, Virginia to Portsmouth / Norfolk, Virginia.

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Virginia Natural Gas Inc
*'''Capacity: '''100,000 Dth/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://southerncompany.mediaroom.com/2008-05-12-Virginia-Natural-Gas-Breaks-Ground-on-Hampton-Roads-Crossing|title=southerncompany.mediaroom.com|website=southerncompany.mediaroom.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''22 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://american-usa.com/news/2013/10/04/american-supplies-22-miles-of-steel-pipe-for-harbor-crossing-pipeline-in-virginia|title=american-usa.com|website=american-usa.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://southerncompany.mediaroom.com/2008-05-12-Virginia-Natural-Gas-Breaks-Ground-on-Hampton-Roads-Crossing|title=southerncompany.mediaroom.com|website=southerncompany.mediaroom.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://american-usa.com/news/2013/10/04/american-supplies-22-miles-of-steel-pipe-for-harbor-crossing-pipeline-in-virginia|title=american-usa.com|website=american-usa.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.virginiaplaces.org/transportation/gaspipeline.html|title=virginiaplaces.org|website=virginiaplaces.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$123,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://southerncompany.mediaroom.com/2008-05-12-Virginia-Natural-Gas-Breaks-Ground-on-Hampton-Roads-Crossing|title=southerncompany.mediaroom.com|website=southerncompany.mediaroom.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
